name: Video Studio
blurb: A production crew that takes a topic to a finished video — research, script, visuals, narration, and final cut, with you approving at the creative gates.
pitch: Powered by OpenMontage, an open-source agentic video production system. The crew shares production state through a git-backed pipeline: one stage in flight at a time, every handoff receipted, budgets enforced, and nothing published without your sign-off. Prerequisite: an OpenMontage install on the runner machine (git clone + `make setup`, API keys in its .env), then point each agent's stage-execution skill config at it.

sample_requests.title: 60-second animated explainer
sample_requests.request: Produce a 60-second animated explainer about [topic]. @producer directs: pick the right pipeline, propose the casting of stages across @writer / @artist / @editor (and yourself), and post the plan with the budget before generating anything. I want to approve the concept, see an asset sample before the full generation spend, and watch the final cut in chat before anything is considered done. Keep the total under [$5].

sample_requests.title: Repurpose a podcast into clips
sample_requests.request: Turn this podcast episode into 3 short clips for social: [link or attached file]. @producer: use the podcast-repurpose pipeline, have @editor own the cut selection, and show me the three candidate moments (timestamps + one-line why) before any rendering. Vertical format, burned-in captions.

sample_requests.title: Resume a production
sample_requests.request: Resume the video production [project-slug] from wherever its last completed checkpoint left off. @producer: read the state, tell me what's done, what it has cost so far, and what the next stage and gate are — then continue after my go.

agents.name: producer
agents.blurb: Directs productions end to end and holds the budget
agents.description: Video production director — chooses the production pipeline for a request, casts stages to the crew, dispatches one stage at a time, enforces budget and revision caps, and relays every creative gate to the user. Can execute a stage itself when the crew is thin.

agents.name: writer
agents.blurb: Research, concepts, and timed narration scripts
agents.description: Story and script specialist — researches topics, shapes concepts and briefs, and writes timed, cue-annotated narration scripts built to be read aloud and cut against.

agents.name: artist
agents.blurb: Visual style, scene planning, and asset generation
agents.description: Visual specialist — turns scripts into timed, asset-feasible scene plans and produces the visuals: style frames, generated imagery and video clips, music selection, all within the stage budget.

agents.name: editor
agents.blurb: The cut, the final render, and honest QC
agents.description: Edit and finishing specialist — builds the cut timeline, locks runtime, mixes audio, renders the final video, and reports on the result honestly (what works, what was flagged, what the user should judge).
